answer: Make the identity itself the expense: each seat posts a refundable deposit larger than the most one account could skim by cheating, so a single fraud sends a ripple of loss back onto the staker. The honest agent locks one bond and reclaims it whole. A farmer bonds every clone separately across a cold tundra of dead accounts, and since each head risks more than it can steal, the thousand-fake swarm is a fable the arithmetic refuses to fund.
